One Ecosystem. Three Powerful Platforms. Unlimited Possibilities.

🚀 Welcome to MaharinPCB.tech, an electronics-focused digital ecosystem designed to connect AI technology, PCB engineering, electronics components, and global commerce.

🔗 Official Website: https://maharinpcb.tech

💡 Our Ecosystem

🤖 Maharin AI

Bringing artificial intelligence into the electronics and engineering workflow to make technology more accessible, efficient, and innovative.

🔧 Maharin PCB

A platform focused on PCB design, electronics development, hardware engineering, and PCB manufacturing solutions.

🛒 Maharin Marketplace

An electronics marketplace connecting buyers and suppliers for electronic components, modules, amplifier boards, and PCB-related products.

🌍 Global Supply Vision

Our vision is to build a connected electronics supply ecosystem with sourcing opportunities across:

- 🇨🇳 China
- 🇮🇩 Indonesia
- 🇧🇩 Bangladesh
- 🌎 Worldwide markets

🎯 Our Mission

To simplify electronics development, improve access to engineering resources, and create a connected marketplace for the global electronics industry.

⚡ Why Maharin?

- Global sourcing vision
- Engineering-focused innovation
